blocks.text: Paulo Avelino pondered on the value of an apparent large sum of “stolen” money in a cryptic post, which fans believe may be alluding to his love-team partner Kim Chiu’s ongoing legal feud with her sister, Lakam Chiu. The actor shared his thoughts via his X page on Thursday, Sept. 24, although he opted not to disclose specific details about whom he was referring to. “I don’t think people understand the value of the ‘amount’ stolen,” he began. “Think about what you would do with that money.
